scope: Phase 8 disposable validation and integrated candidate experiments; not final release certification
fixed_context: The accepted fictional catchment, public name references, patient identities, worker histories and vocabulary stay fixed across seeds. Comparison seeds regenerate demand, bed placement, clinical care, labor, inventory and finance over all 36 months at full scale, exceeding the requested representative scale. Experiments are never combined or published as business rows.
seed_policy: Primary 20261023 plus 20261024 and 20261025; no seed search or rejection of a seed for appearance. Every configured seed must pass hard invariants and applicable realism targets. A failing seed blocks acceptance.
version_1_1_budget_amendment: Version 1.1 records realistic unplanned RN absences (about 2.5% of routine unit shifts, higher in winter). Each absence retains the absent roster history and a distinct replacement attendance. Reassign 3000 unused bed_event slots to staff_shift: bed_event=77000 (-3000), staff_shift=73000 (+3000). Total remains 1995215 plus 4785 reserve. No facts removed, sampled away or truncated to meet a cap.
version_1_1_behaviour_revision: Version 1.1 regenerates every seed, including the primary, from the accepted master snapshot with: right-skewed ED stays; ward-round readiness and a daytime discharge window; variable bed placement and cleaning response; weekend outpatient/elective draws spread across weekdays; person-level no-show propensity at fixed outcome totals; payer/setting/stay/complexity/billing-delay denial propensity normalized to the 900 basis-point rate; seasonal RN absences covered by agency staff or colleague pickups. Master, reference and driver facts are unchanged. Behaviour checks in behaviour-revision.json are mandatory for every seed.
budget_amendment: Reassign 20000 unused slots to claim_event for corrected payer/denial histories: clinical_event=570000 (-10000), clinical_condition=82000 (-3000), inventory_movement=50000 (-5000), cost_allocation=163000 (-2000), claim_event=240000 (+20000). Total remains 1995215 plus 4785 reserve. No facts removed, sampled away or truncated to meet a cap.
calibration_correction: Phase 6 base initial-denial probability 450 basis points produced 2296/46525=4.93498%, below the predeclared 8-12% target. Set base probability to 900, retain all authorization causes, patient statements, denominators and censoring. Regenerate claims, journals, allocations, plan vintages, exports, reviews and evidence. Do not lower the target.
master_context_migration: Version integrated-master-context-v1 retains all accepted identities, enrollment/knowledge intervals, coverage IDs and worker birth years. Original enrollment renewal/change selection suppressed Medicare (22.47%) and inflated Medicaid (22.30%) against frozen 35%/15% targets. Prospective age-eligible payer weights apply equally to original and renewed enrollments: under65 COMMERCIAL64/MEDICAID24/SELF_PAY12; age65plus MEDICARE95/COMMERCIAL4/SELF_PAY1. Stable product/renewal records of the selected class are retained where compatible. Status/member tokens follow selected payer type. Worker month/day is varied by stable worker key using the actual birth-year calendar, fixing 282 June15 and 18 January15 source imputations. The migration does not inspect future care or cash. Old snapshots remain immutable; this is a new dataset baseline, not an incremental update of immutable source IDs. Never mix old/new baseline deliveries. All dependent data, reviews and controls regenerate.
statistical_policy: Use the frozen realism-targets.json and clinical/resource/operational thresholds. No new empirical prevalence claims. Age and payer targets use their original absolute tolerances. Subgroups with n<200 retain counts and Wilson intervals, are not failed by arbitrary subgroup percentages. Conditional clinical, stock and staffing checks use existing scoped domain validators, freshly executed. All 36 months and three facilities must be represented.
partition_policy: Require every month/facility/encounter-class combination. Physical ICU placement is a state, not a separate arrival class. No claim outcomes or performed services are required in an unobserved future interval. Finance zero cells are legitimate configured selected capture, while absent plan series remain missing.
point_in_time: Use source-known and delivery timestamps; choose latest delivered revision before checking its business validity. Ignore retrospective known_to as a historical feature. Actual service, late diagnoses, discharge, attendance and forecast vintage cannot be used before availability. Readmission negatives require live eligible discharge plus 30 days of complete observed followup; insufficient followup is UNKNOWN.
fanout_policy: Aggregate each fact to its declared grain before joins; diagnoses and events are existence/semi-join predicates. Select one cost run per posting and one finance vintage per series/scenario. Do not sum stock quantities across unlike products, balance sheet across months, liability with cash, or payer attempts as originals.
review_selection: Stable SHA256 order within month/facility/class; retain one complete named-patient trace from each of 108 month/facility strata and additional rare/open/corrected cases. Review sample and selected facts are hash-bound. Samples do not replace full-population checks.
review_authority: User-designated synthetic business, clinical, workforce, finance and data reviewer. No external licensed clinical, accountant or vendor endorsement.
acceptance: No unresolved P0/P1, no unexplained reconciliation differences, all registered seeds/consumer/fault/PIT controls pass and review binds current data and evidence. Phase 9 clean-environment certification and explicit business release acceptance remain pending; full_dataset_accepted=false and BLOCKED_FOR_SOLUTION.
